A '''golden carrot cupcake''' is the secret meal of the [[Golden Carrot|golden carrot]]. It heals {{Hp|8}} and grants {{EffectLink|Night Vision}} for 20 minutes, the longest Night Vision in the pack.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/crafting/golden_carrot_cupcake.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
A golden carrot, sugar, estus ash, cocoa beans and dough. The recipe is secret.

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating it takes 1.6 seconds, heals {{Hp|8}} and gives Night Vision for 20:00. Making it grants ''Wait, you can make that?''
